{{Vanilla|Cobblestone}}
{{Infobox auto}}
'''Cobblestone''' is the rough stone that [[limestone]] (stone) drops when mined. In [[Matcha Flavoured]] it is the start of the pack's rock-processing chain: a [[Mud Kiln|mud kiln]] fires it into limestone and a [[Blast Furnace|blast furnace]] breaks it down into [[gravel]].

== Obtaining ==
=== Breaking ===
Limestone drops cobblestone when mined without Silk Touch, as in vanilla.

=== Crafting and smelting ===
{{Recipes}}
* Four flint in a square make 1 cobblestone.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/cobblestone.json}}</ref>
* A blast furnace turns limestone back into cobblestone ({{Value|Cobblestone|cook_time|station=Blast Furnace}}).
* An [[oven]] turns mossy cobblestone into cobblestone.
* Two cobblestone slabs craft back into a block.

== Usage ==
{{Uses}}
* Fired in a mud kiln, cobblestone becomes limestone; the vanilla furnace recipe is removed.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/pack.mcmeta}}</ref>
* Blasted, it becomes gravel ({{Value|Gravel|cook_time|station=Blast Furnace}}).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blast/gravel.json}}</ref>
* Two cobblestone and two [[quartz]] make 4 [[diorite]].
